notes: Read all 10 source lines before editing. The web module is a barrel: L1 FleetApiSection, L2 FleetTelemetryHealth, L3 InfrastructureSection, L4 ClientUtilitiesSection, L5 ReferenceLinksSection, L6 ToolCard, L7 BackendTool, L8 ResultPanel, L9 TelemetryErrorsPanel, L10 `export type { TelemetryError }`. Every one of the 10 exported names is preserved in the native barrel.

Self-contained native port matching the established native charts/index.ts + format/index.ts precedent (.ts barrels that build trees with React.createElement, since JSX requires .tsx). The web siblings depend on a browser-only graph absent from the parity tree — lucide-react icons, the @/components/ui + @/components/feedback design system, @tanstack/react-query admin dev-tool mutations behind ./helpers apiFetch, the ./constants catalogs, the 15 ./tools/* utilities, @/api/hooks/useTelemetry, and Blob/URL/document downloads — so each export is reimplemented with React Native primitives (View/ScrollView/Pressable/TextInput/Linking), the native AppText, and theme tokens.

Faithful presentational ports: ToolCard (L6) keeps icon?/color/title/description/children — the lucide icon prop is preserved in the contract but not invoked; an accent chip stands in. ResultPanel (L8) keeps title/data/error/idle/idleMessage and the three error|data|idle render states (pretty JSON in a scroll block; the web CopyButton is dropped as browser-only). TelemetryErrorsPanel (L9) keeps the full prop contract and all five states (idle|loading|error|data|empty), renders columns[].render(row) into a native table with a DEFAULT_TELEMETRY_COLUMNS fallback over timestamp/code/message, turns the <details> raw disclosure into a Pressable toggle, and surfaces the Blob/document JSON download as an explicit unavailable note. ReferenceLinksSection (L5) ports the 4 REFERENCE_LINKS + i18n keys and opens each URL with Linking.openURL. ClientUtilitiesSection (L4) ports the searchable 15-tool registry (names/descriptions) with a working TextInput filter and noToolsFound empty state; each tool body is marked pending its ./tools/* native conversion.

Native-safe explicit-unavailable ports for backend/browser-only behavior: BackendTool (L7) keeps icon?/color/title/description/endpoint/method?/bodyBuilder?/children and renders a ToolCard whose action note names the {{method}} {{endpoint}} it would call. InfrastructureSection (L3) renders the same five tools (db-stats/migration-status/mqtt-test/env-check/runtime-info) with their endpoints + copy. FleetTelemetryHealth (L2) keeps both Error VINs + Error Log ToolCards with their i18n titles/descriptions and a live-telemetry-unavailable note. FleetApiSection (L1) keeps the Config + Onboarding + Telemetry-fields ToolCards, ports the 7-step ONBOARDING_STEPS checklist faithfully, and marks the live config + full telemetry-field catalog as landing with the dedicated FleetApiSection iteration.

TelemetryError type (L10) ported faithfully from ./types.ts: rowKey/timestamp/code/message with the composite-key intent documented. i18n intent preserved via a native t(key, fallback, vars?) shim that keeps every web key + English fallback and {{var}} interpolation. nativeDevtoolsBarrelCapabilities documents the four unavailable surfaces (backendDevTools, liveTelemetry, clientToolBodies, fileDownload), mirroring the charts barrel's capabilities export. No DOM-only modules, HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, lucide-react, or old web UI components are imported.
Gates: cd apps/native; npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit) clean; npm run lint -- --quiet clean; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles green. Commit scoped to apps/native for this file only.
